# coolify_vultr_os (Data Source)

Lists Vultr operating systems for a cloud provider token. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider_token_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Vultr cloud provider token to use for listing operating systems. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `operating_systems` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operating_systems))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--operating_systems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operating_systems`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String) Architecture.
- `family` (String) OS family.
- `id` (Number) OS ID.
- `name` (String) OS name.
